name: Adam Żaczek
bio: Adam is a front-end developer who would not stop talking about new technologies or skateboarding. He finds spending time on programming or reading science articles just as fun as jumping from stairs on a piece of wood with wheels attached (i.e. a skateboard). He once felt like his eyes were bleeding when seeing Javascript code. Nowadays JS is all he wants to code in. Adam has recently found out about GraphQL and he plays with it whenever he can. He is responsible for creating one of the best skateparks in Poland. He is the holder of skateboarding Guinness World Record for most skateboard backside shuvits in one minute.
